summary: EfficientNet-B5 Phase 2 (frozen phase1 heads) on full images (data2). lr=1e-4, backbone-lr-scale=0.1, wd=0.01, bs=12, grad-accum-steps=2, 30 epochs. Loaded phase1 checkpoint. Phase1 heads frozen for all epochs. Best overall accuracy 74.41% at epoch 3. New tasks (arch_style, building_form) converged quickly but plateaued. Phase1 tasks regressed despite frozen heads, confirming backbone drift is the limiting factor. Run performed on remote machine, results consistent with local runs.

comparison.vs_b5_crop_v3_phase2: Full images: overall 74.41%, arch_style 73.03%. Crops: overall 75.87%, arch_style 71.98%. Crops win on stories (+3.7pp) and cladding (+4.5pp), full images win on arch_style (+1.1pp).
comparison.vs_b5_full_v1_phase2: Consistent with prior full image runs. Freezing phase1 heads does not prevent regression on phase1 tasks.

learnings: Backbone drift is the limiting factor for phase1 task retention, even with frozen heads.
Full images slightly outperform crops on architectural style, but lag on stories and cladding.
Results are robust across machines and data splits.
